label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, late in the episode (trial >= ~70)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and only late in the episode: zero activity before trial 60, then the rate ramps up through trials 70-99 (75% of activation mass is in trials 90-99). 98% of mass is on D1 steps where the reward input is 0, i.e. the previous trial went unrewarded. It barely fires after rewarded trials (rate 0.2%). It also fires on D1 fixation errors (17.7x lift, small mass) and goes with low model value (all mass below value 7.1). The predicate D1 & ep_trial>=80 & prev_reward==0 covers 95% of activation mass on dev (P 0.33, R 0.72, F1 0.45). Precision is limited because many late unrewarded D1 steps stay silent, and no history variable I tried (two unrewarded in a row, common vs rare transition, previous action, value) separates them cleanly. Magnitude rises with trial number in the episode: the predicate covers about 100% of the top two activation quartiles but only 18% of the lowest one, and the low quartile sits mostly around trials 70-80. So this looks like an episode clock (time into the episode) gated on no reward at D1. It uses only observed variables.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (D1: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, ?) and this reward (future) (D1: -2, -1); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=9, phase=D1 & ep_dec=8, phase=D1 & ep_dec=7.
